name: Cryonic-Carn

civilization.name: The Pale Assemblies
civilization.notes: Long dead; only ruins and orbital debris remain of a civilization that flourished before the world turned hostile.

description: Bare rock from pole to pole, shaded in grays, ox-blood reds, and pale magnesium white. The regolith records four billion years of bombardment, scarred through by massive canyon systems near the terminator.
No wind, no voice, no weather: the landscape communicates in light and shadow alone, and it has plenty to say at sunrise.
Surveyors date the buried megastructure to before the region's last cataclysm, which should be impossible. The structures are unweathered, as if time skipped this place.
Opportunity here wears armor. Claims on aluminum, titanium and silicon are staked, defended, and occasionally avenged, and the nearest law is a week's burn away.
